task: Implement Phase 8 milestone 7A as typed, durable, restart-safe execution, analysis, artifact-lineage, and knowledge contracts with deterministic dry-run adapters only; preserve approval and manual-activation authorization, visibly separate mock evidence from measured evidence, and leave every real provider, knowledge-store, lab, robot, and wet-lab integration disabled and external.
acceptanceCriteria: Phase 8 is complete only for the 7A mocks/contracts milestone: deterministic dry-run adapters and disabled-real sentinels exist, while real Flywheel/HPC, knowledge-store, lab, robot, hardware, network, and measured-evidence paths remain unreachable external gates.

Typed immutable execution, analysis, artifact-reference, interpretation, knowledge-version, conflict, status, evidence-kind, failure-code, and measured-receipt contracts fail closed on malformed, mixed-basis, unsafe-location, or unsupported-real inputs.

Migration 010 creates exactly five additive durable tables for execution runs, analysis runs, artifact references, knowledge versions, and conflict records without modifying migrations 008 or 009, deleting history, or persisting credentials, raw provider bodies, capability URLs, or arbitrary provider errors.

Execution and analysis lifecycle state is canvas-scoped, idempotent, restart-safe, reconcile-before-retry, and claim-safe under concurrent reconciliation so one ambiguous idempotency key cannot produce duplicate adapter submissions.

Phase 8 dispatch requires current proposal and validation-result hash authorization and preserves the credential-verified, hash-bound manual activation gate for first-round manual execution; Canvas Notes, titles, connectors, markers, model text, and Browser projections remain non-authorizing.

Terminal restart recovery settles submit intents with persisted provider identifiers, append-only artifact and knowledge lineage remains immutable, and conflicts preserve prior and proposed versions with exact evidence and hypothesis hashes.

Every Phase 8 output is visibly labelled DRY RUN / MOCK — NOT MEASURED, Browser evidence projections omit logical storage locations, Canvus lifecycle buckets are display-only, execution_enabled remains false, and the legacy multi-round synthetic MOCK_RESULT loop remains compatible.

Focused and full tests, Ruff, mypy, compileall, workflow parity, whitespace checks, documentation reconciliation, and adversarial re-review pass with score at least 9.5, zero Critical or High findings, and no real-execution or scientific-truth overclaim.
blastRadius: approval freshness, ordered approval evidence, and manual execution activation
SQLite migrations, intent claims, lifecycle transitions, restart reconciliation, and rerun/abort lineage
mock-versus-measured evidence truth boundary and artifact location redaction
append-only knowledge versions, conflict preservation, and canvas-scoped provenance
watcher scheduling, Browser artifact projections, and Canvus display-only topology
legacy multi-round synthetic loop, notification, artifact, approval, and ingestion regressions
canonical specification, architecture, workflow, operations, roadmap, changelog, README, and code standards
contracts: The installed Phase 8 adapters are deterministic memory-only dry runs; disabled-real sentinels fail closed and no real provider request or credential schema is invented.
side_effect_intents owns durable submit, abort, ambiguity, and reconciliation identity; workflow_attempts owns watcher scheduling and cannot authorize a provider retry.
Only current durable proposal and validation hashes plus ordered approvals and, for first-round manual mode, the exact manual activation can authorize Phase 8 dispatch.
One atomic intent claim permits a proved-absent retry; competing reconcilers return durable state and cannot submit again.
Artifact references use bounded mock or opaque logical identifiers, never local paths or capability URLs, and Browser payloads do not expose logical storage locations.
Knowledge versions and conflicts are insert-only, canvas-scoped, evidence-bound, and preserve both sides without scientific adjudication or automatic resolution.
All mock outputs carry MOCK_OR_DRY_RUN and the visible DRY RUN / MOCK — NOT MEASURED label; no mock output can satisfy measured-evidence or real-execution predicates.
No failing test, lint, type, compilation, parity, documentation, or inspection result may be represented as a passing delivery gate.
